text.title: Single Channel Bet Selector — Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable founder and channel signals (existing revenue channel, ICP sample, rubric scores, kill criterion) to a rule from `01-core-rules.xml`. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is any channel already producing measurable revenue (at least one paying customer per month attributable to it)?

conclusion.verdict: do not re-pick; keep executing the working channel and revisit only when it saturates

branch.question: Does the founder have at least 5 paying customers or 50 qualified conversations from which channel behaviour can be counted?

conclusion.verdict: no density evidence exists; run customer discovery until the sample threshold is met, then return

branch.question: Does the written rubric contain 3 to 6 tactic-level candidates, and does the top candidate score at least 12 of 15 with every axis at 3 or above?

conclusion.verdict: return no bet; instrument early traction on the highest scorer or widen the candidate set, do not pick the least-bad option

branch.question: Is a numeric week-12 kill criterion, the weekly unit of work and the week-4 / week-8 checkpoints written and dated on the same day as the selection?

conclusion.verdict: write the number, the follow-up action, the weekly unit and both checkpoints before the 90-day clock starts
commit to the single channel, park the rest with scores, and start the 90 days

text.example: working_channel_exists=false -> icp_sample_sufficient=true -> rubric_clears=true -> kill_criterion_dated=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
